lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: This is the Last Lighthouse. The light is lit.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Last Lighthouse, on one hundred and twenty one point five. Listening, as always.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Last Lighthouse. If you can see the light, you are not lost.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: If you can hear this, you are not alone.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Last Lighthouse. Keeping the light, for anyone out there.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: It is the usual hour. This is the Night Forecast, from the Last Lighthouse.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Keeper's Log. Entries from the book on the desk, read by lamplight.

clips.title: The Forecast for the Impossible Seas

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: And now the forecast for the impossible seas, issued from the Last Lighthouse at the usual hour.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: There are warnings of gales in Gannet's Regret, Outer Soup, and Inner Soup.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Lesser Marrow, Greater Marrow. Southwesterly, four or five, backing sideways later. Rain, then memories. Moderate or good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Tuesday Reach. Northerly, three, becoming Wednesday. Fair. Good, occasionally very good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Outer Soup, Inner Soup. Gale eight, stirring clockwise. Thick. Visibility, a spoon's length.

clips.title: The Forecast for the Impossible Seas

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Far Nonsuch, Near Nonsuch. Variable, two, from no direction in particular. Fog patches, some of them shaped like people you used to know. Poor, becoming kind.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Lullaby Bank. Westerly, one or two, humming. Showers of moths. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Thimble. Calm. Very small. Visibility, the whole of Thimble.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Mothering Sound. Easterly, five, tucking in later. Drizzle. Moderate.

clips.title: The Forecast for the Impossible Seas

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Spindles. Northwesterly, six, spinning. Squally, with occasional wool. Moderate, occasionally tangled.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Velvet Deep. Southerly, three. Dark, but in a nice way. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Hesitation. Wind, possibly. Weather, perhaps. Visibility, it depends.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Saltlight. Easterly, four. Bright, with stars below the surface. Excellent.

clips.title: The Forecast for the Impossible Seas

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: North Elsewhere, South Elsewhere. Westerly, veering to somebody else's west. Rain, elsewhere. Good, here.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Quiet Rows. Calm. Silent. Visibility good, but nobody is looking.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Old Pardon. Northeasterly, five, forgiving later. Showers, then clear. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Biscuit Shoals. Southwesterly, three. Crumbly. Moderate. Mariners are advised to dunk with care.

clips.title: The Forecast for the Impossible Seas

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Mirrorline. Wind from the left, which is also the right. Fair, reflected. Visibility, both ways.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Underneath. No wind. No weather. Nobody has been. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Dimity. Easterly, two. Lace fog in places. Moderate or good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Wren. Westerly, one. Small and brave. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The general synopsis, at midnight.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Low, Lesser Marrow, nine hundred and ninety, moving slowly toward a decision.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: High, Saltlight, one thousand and thirty, staying where it is, as it always does.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: A ridge of good intentions extends across the Quiet Rows, and is expected to hold.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: And now the reports from the lights, at midnight.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Last Lighthouse. Southwesterly, three. Clear. One thousand and twelve, steady. One keeper, awake.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The lighthouse at Candlemouth. No report.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: There has been no report from Candlemouth for some years. I read its name anyway. Somebody should.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: And the forecast for inshore waters, from the rock to the end of the light.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Westerly, two. The waves are coming in, as they do, and going out again, as they also do. Visibility, as far as the beam.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: That is the forecast. Good night, to anyone out there.

clips.title: The Forecast for the Impossible Seas

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Gannet's Regret. Northerly, five, apologising later. Showers. Moderate.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Yarrow Gap. Southeasterly, four. Rain, with the smell of a garden somewhere. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Dimity. Calm. Mist, lifting by morning. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Starboard of Everything. Variable. Who can say. Who can say.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The forecast for the impossible seas, on the last night of October.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Gannet's Regret. Northerly, five, moaning slightly. Sheets of rain, some with eyeholes. Poor, then boo.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Underneath. Something knocking. Probably the sea. Good.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Velvet Deep. Calm. A lantern seen at the surface, carved, smiling. Visibility, good, if you're brave.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. The light was lit at dusk, as usual. No ships passed.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: One reflection of a ship passed, and waved. I waved back. Entered it anyway.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. A gull came to the window and stayed for the whole forecast.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: It did not leave a name. Gulls never do. It is welcome back.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. Received a faint signal tonight, from a relay ship. The Nightjar.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Somebody up there is listening. I read the forecast a little more carefully.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. Polished the lens. Wound the clock. Made the tea. Read the forecast. Nobody came.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: It was a good night. They are all good nights, when nobody is in trouble.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. The sea was very calm tonight, and very far down. I think it is shy.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I have stopped looking at it directly. It seems to prefer that.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. Ninety thousand nights, give or take. I have not missed one.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I do not say that to boast. I say it so that someone knows.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. A bottle washed up with a message in it. The message said, is anyone there.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I have written, yes, on the back, and put it back in the sea. It will get there.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. Heard the time signal through the static tonight. Set the clock by it. It was wrong.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I set it anyway. It is good to agree with somebody.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. The beam went round eleven thousand times tonight. I counted the first hundred, and then I just watched.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Some things are better watched than counted.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Logbook. Something tapped at the bottom of the radio band again. A hello, I think, very slow.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I tapped back on the desk. I don't know if it carries. It seemed only right.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Notice to mariners. The rock at the edge of Far Nonsuch has moved again. It apologises.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Please give it a wide berth while it settles.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Notice to mariners. A small island has been reported drifting south of Thimble.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: It is friendly. Please do not land on it without asking.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I am sometimes asked, by nobody, why I keep the light when no ships come.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: On the first night, there was a ship. One small ship, with a lantern at the bow, a long way out, in weather.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: It saw the light. And it turned. And it went home safely.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I never saw it again. That is how you know it worked.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: So I keep the light. In case. Just in case.
